sentences.text: Hmph. I have reviewed the data, and I find no evidence of any spectral activity; the house was merely behaving according to physics, E1.
Between 04:00 and 06:00, the humidity in the ironing room dropped significantly to 32.8 %, which is below the expected range of 37.0 % to 38.1 %, E1.
This sharp decline suggests that something caused the air to dry out, perhaps an open window or a sudden change in temperature settings, E1.
Therefore, it is probably a mundane environmental fluctuation, not a haunting, despite the observed value being 32.8 % instead of the expected 37.5 %, E1.
